ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_RES_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE POPULATE_RES_INFO IS
 CURSOR resource_cur(dt_to_chk_active_resource date) IS
 SELECT resource_code, resource_desc 
 FROM valid_resources 
 WHERE resource_code = NVL(:ctrl_block.resource_code, resource_code) 
 AND dt_to_chk_active_resource BETWEEN eff_date 
 AND NVL(term_date, dt_to_chk_active_resource +1) 
 ORDER BY resource_code ;
 max_aval NUMBER ;
 bkd_res NUMBER ;
 index_date DATE ;
/* Modified and verified for Y2k ..Sobha....06/99 */
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('resource_stat');
 FIRST_RECORD ;

 MESSAGE('Working...');
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE, 'BUSY');
 --pitss synchronize ;

 index_date := :ctrl_block.start_date ;

 WHILE index_date <= :ctrl_block.end_date LOOP
 FOR resource_rec IN resource_cur(index_date) LOOP 
 SELECT TO_CHAR(index_date,'MM-DD-YYYY') || ' ' || TO_CHAR(index_date,'DY')
 INTO :resource_stat.drive_date 
 FROM dual ;
 :resource_stat.resource_code := resource_rec.resource_code ;
 :resource_stat.resource_desc := resource_rec.resource_desc ;

 don_mcal_common.get_resource_util(index_date,
 :global.chapter_id,
 null,
 resource_rec.resource_code,
 bkd_res,
 max_aval ) ;
 :resource_stat.booked_res := bkd_res ;
 :resource_stat.exception_res := max_aval ;
 :resource_stat.avail_res := nvl(max_aval,0) - nvl(bkd_res,0) ;

/* Calculate MAX Resource */
 BEGIN 
 SELECT max_available 
 INTO :resource_stat.maximum_res 
 FROM resource_avail_rules
 WHERE week_day = TO_CHAR(index_date,'DY')
 AND resource_code = resource_rec.resource_code
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 AND index_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,index_date+1) ;

 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN :resource_stat.maximum_res := NULL ;
 END ;

/*
 BEGIN
 SELECT available_number 
 INTO :resource_stat.exception_res 
 FROM resource_exceptions
 WHERE drive_date = INDEX_DATE
 AND resource_code = resource_rec.resource_code
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :resource_stat.exception_res := NULL ;
 END ;
*/
 
 NEXT_RECORD ;
 END LOOP ;
 
 index_date := index_date + 1 ; 
 END LOOP ;
 CLEAR_MESSAGE ;
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
END ;
